propositions: Plan-material-pin health including drift, enforcement posture, and phase compatibility must be exposed in detailed review surfaces (CLI show, MCP detail, audit, close errors, web UI) without adding noise to ordinary list output or creating persistent warning events.

All detailed renderers must consume the DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract and display normalized role, pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, signed review phase, required phase, and effective execution floor using canonical status strings.

Pin enforcement drift must be displayed as visibly advisory when disabled, legacy-unpinned cases must be distinguishable from current-no-relationships, and ordinary list output plus persisted ticket events must remain unchanged.

Output schemas, rendering tests, and advanced plan-review/attestation documentation must be updated to cover pins, phases, toggles, deleted targets, and close-versus-claim freshness while excluding this material from basic user docs.

Audit rendering integration must call compute_validity with best-effort stored data and repo root, catching missing attestation or timeouts and rendering as clearly labeled derived-health unavailable without changing audit_trail never-raise behavior.
Close-error rendering must surface human-readable validity failures without silently changing allow/deny semantics, and schema changes must be additive with preserved rollback compatibility.
